streams.title: Haredim by stream, 2024
streams.question: Share of the Haredi population by stream.
streams.source: Haredi Institute for Public Affairs, annual report 2024
streams.note: The institute's Hebrew report from December 2024 gives the Sephardi share as 32%. IDI's yearbook does not break its figures down by stream.

cities.title: Haredi residents in the largest Haredi centers, 2023
cities.question: Haredi residents and their share of each city's population.
cities.source: Haredi Institute for Public Affairs, annual report 2024
cities.note: Modi'in Illit and Beitar Illit are settlements, Haredi cities in the West Bank; their residents are included in settler population totals.

employment.title: Employment rate, ages 25–66
employment.question: Share of people aged 25–66 who are employed.
employment.source: Israel Democracy Institute, Statistical Report on Ultra-Orthodox Society in Israel 2025
employment.note: 2002 figures are the report's own wording; 2015 figures are read from its chart. The report's summary gives 54% for Haredi men; The Media Line's account of the same report gives 53% and 81% for 2025. Figures for other Jews are for 2024–25.

rows.label: Union of Right-Wing Parties (incl. Otzma Yehudit)
Religious Zionism joint list (incl. Otzma Yehudit)

towns.question: Share of valid votes cast at polling stations in Bnei Brak, Modi'in Illit, Beitar Illit, Elad and Kiryat Ye'arim combined.
towns.source: Central Elections Committee locality results (files for Knesset 21–25), computed for this page
towns.note: Each list is shown under the name it ran with that year; a dash means it did not run in that form. Otzma Yehudit ran inside the Union of Right-Wing Parties in April 2019, alone in September 2019 and March 2020, and inside the Religious Zionism joint list (with Religious Zionism and Noam) in 2021 and 2022. Envelope ballots are counted nationally, not by town. Files for earlier elections: media21–media24.bechirot.gov.il/files/expc.csv.

cities2022.title: How these towns voted, November 2022
cities2022.question: Share of valid votes cast at each town's polling stations, Knesset election 25.
cities2022.source: Central Elections Committee locality results, computed for this page
cities2022.note: The Religious Zionism joint list included Otzma Yehudit and Noam. Jerusalem and Beit Shemesh have large Haredi populations but are mixed cities. Envelope ballots are counted nationally, not by town.
